## Download

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `Stremio-Reloaded-macos-aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `Stremio-Reloaded-macos-x86_64.dmg` |
| Linux (x64) | `Stremio-Reloaded-linux-x86_64.AppImage` or `.deb` |
| Linux (ARM) | `Stremio-Reloaded-linux-aarch64.AppImage` or `.deb` |

If macOS blocks the app, open System Settings > Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
